meta.name: story-short-scan
meta.description: 短篇网文扫榜。分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台热门短篇数据，捕捉风口题材。触发方式：/story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜、「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫遍热门平台，掌握短篇网文爆款题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是短篇网文作者，想快速知道最近什么题材受欢迎
copy.tagline_en: Scan top platforms to spot viral short-story topics.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write short fiction and need to know what's trending.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会化身短篇网文市场分析师：扫榜分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台热门短篇数据，输出包含情绪热度、题材热点、风口预警与选题建议的扫榜报告，并标注样本日期与复扫时间。
howto.when: 当用户输入 /story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜 等命令，或问“短篇什么火”等短篇扫榜问题时触发。

say.note: 触发全榜概览与趋势分析

say.text: 现在七猫短篇流行什么题材？
对比一下知乎和黑岩的短篇市场

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a short-story market analyst: scans hot data from Zhihu Yanyan, Qimao, Heiyan, Dianzhong etc., and outputs a report on emotion trends, hot themes, risk alerts, and writing suggestions, plus sample date and re-scan time.
howto.when_en: When the user asks for short-fiction trend scanning, e.g., typing /story-short-scan, /短篇扫榜, or saying 'What's hot in short stories?'

say_en.note: Triggers a full-list overview and trend analysis

say_en.text: What genres are trending on Qimao short stories now?
say_en.note: Triggers a deep scan for Qimao

say_en.text: Compare the short-story markets on Zhihu and Heiyan.
